term_rules.label: Appeal to HMRC
term_rules.basis: Section 31A Taxes Management Act 1970: notice of appeal within 30 days after the date of the notice.
term_rules.notes: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland share this rule for income tax. Late appeals are possible only with a reasonable excuse.

term_rules.label: Cancellation period
term_rules.basis: Regulation 30 of the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013: 14 days after the goods come into the consumer's possession.
term_rules.notes: v_purchase_rights counts from the order mail, which errs early.

term_rules.label: Short-term right to reject
term_rules.basis: Section 22 Consumer Rights Act 2015: 30 days after ownership passes and the goods are delivered, to reject faulty goods for a full refund.
term_rules.notes: After that the right to repair or replacement continues; claims can be brought for up to six years (five in Scotland).

annual_dates.label: Submit the Self Assessment return online
annual_dates.basis: Section 8 Taxes Management Act 1970: online returns by 31 January after the end of the tax year (6 April to 5 April). Paper returns by 31 October.
annual_dates.notes: tax_year is the calendar year in which the tax year ends: 2026 means 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026, due 31 January 2027.

facts.text: A TV Licence is needed to watch live TV or use BBC iPlayer. It can be cancelled, with a refund of full unused months, when it is no longer needed.
